s.n: Bread and butter fried chicken sliders
s.note: Cube tells Dre he's their bread and butter.
s.how: Soak the chicken in the buttermilk with a big pinch of salt. Toss in the flour seasoned with the paprika and cayenne until shaggy. Fry in oil at 170C until deep golden and cooked through. Fill the rolls with mayo, chicken and pickles.

s.note: Crinkle fries loaded with beef chilli and melted cheddar, Ruthless Records style.
s.how: Bake the fries at 220C until crisp. Brown the mince and onion, add the spices and tomatoes and simmer until thick. Pile the fries on a tray, spoon over the chilli and scatter with cheese. Grill until melted and finish with spring onion.

m.note: Charred skirt steak tacos with salsa, Compton style.
m.how: Marinate the steak in the juice of 2 limes and the orange with the garlic, cumin, oil and salt. Grill over high heat, 3 minutes a side, rest it, then chop small. Warm the tortillas on the grill. Top with steak, salsa verde, onion and coriander, with lime wedges.

m.note: Franks, chilli and mustard in soft buns, Detroit show night.
m.how: Brown the mince, breaking it up finely, then add the spices, tomato paste and a cup of water and simmer until saucy. Grill the franks until blistered. Warm the rolls, add the franks and spoon over the chilli. Finish with mustard and raw onion.

w.note: Warm peach cobbler with vanilla ice cream.
w.how: Toss the peaches with half the sugar, the cinnamon and cornflour in a baking dish. Rub the butter into the flour and the rest of the sugar, then stir in the buttermilk. Drop spoonfuls over the peaches and bake at 190C until golden and bubbling. Serve warm with ice cream.

d.note: Watermelon, lime and mint over ice.
d.how: Blend the watermelon with the lime juice, sugar and water until smooth, then strain. Pour over ice and mint in 4 tall glasses.
